title: A003: Add minimal GitHub Actions CI workflow
summary: Minimal GitHub Actions CI workflow with 3 parallel jobs (lint, test, test-integration) in a single 46-line YAML file. SPDX header, least-privilege permissions, concurrency control, and reference documentation all present and correct.

review_steps.1_INTENT: Plan specifies a minimal CI workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yaml) with 3 parallel jobs (lint, test, test-integration), SPDX header, least-privilege permissions, and concurrency control. 8 requirements (REQ-001 through REQ-008).
review_steps.2_SCOPE: Changed files: .github/workflows/ci.yaml (new), docs/ci-workflow.md (new), .planwerk/progress/CC-0003-*.json (modified). No scope creep — no image builds, no Helm, no E2E/Chainsaw, no coverage, no matrix builds, no branch protection.
review_steps.3_VERIFICATION: YAML syntax validated via python yaml.safe_load — VALID. Infrastructure YAML file — V1/V2/V3 (pytest/mypy/ruff) not applicable.
review_steps.4_PATTERNS: First workflow file in the repository — no existing workflow conventions to compare against on main. SPDX header format, quoted 'on', .yaml extension, permissions, and concurrency group all follow the conventions specified in the plan.
review_steps.5_TESTS: Infrastructure YAML — no automated tests applicable. All 16 verification checks from test_specifications confirmed via manual inspection.
review_steps.6_SECURITY: permissions: contents: read at top level, no job-level overrides, no secrets used, no hardcoded credentials. Actions pinned by major version tag (@v4, @v5, @v9) — standard GHA practice.
review_steps.7_COMPLEXITY: 46 lines, 3 jobs, minimal configuration. This is the simplest possible implementation for the requirements.
review_steps.8_COMPLETENESS: All 8 requirements met. All 12 tasks marked done. Reference documentation at docs/ci-workflow.md accurately describes the implementation.

detected_patterns.name: GitHub Actions workflow structure conventions
detected_patterns.applies_when: Creating any new GitHub Actions workflow file
detected_patterns.description: Workflow files use .yaml extension, quote the 'on' key as '"on"' to prevent YAML boolean interpretation, declare top-level 'permissions: contents: read' for least privilege, and include a concurrency group '${{ github.ref }}-${{ github.workflow }}' with cancel-in-progress: true. Runner is ubuntu-latest.

examples.code:
"on":
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.ref }}-${{ github.workflow }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
